placement_after: “You’ve got cabbage on your foot,” Shadow told Neet between bites.
alt_text: Neet accepts the market’s rewards with a cabbage leaf still stuck to his paw.
scene_brief: After monkey rescue at an Indian produce market at evening. Neet stands beside a basket of biscuits and scraps, looking grandly self-satisfied, with one crumpled GREEN CABBAGE LEAF stuck around one front paw like an accidental slipper. Buddy stands nearby with one biscuit on the ground by his paws, looking down at the leaf with restrained amusement. Both full bodies on clear shared cobbled ground, smooth short coats and low tiny/slender tails. Behind are upright produce crates, cabbages and a few spilled tomatoes being tidied; no active monkeys or fight, no extra dogs/human faces. The leaf on the hero's paw is the visual joke.
